speaker: Mon3tr
content: (Excited roar)

content: Mon3tr appears by your side, but its stance is slightly different than usual.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

content: Without a command from Kal'tsit, it zips towards the enemy, although a cluster of Originium rises from the ground, fully encasing the monster within.

speaker: Priestess
content: You really have surprised me, AMa-10.

raw: [name="Priestess"]You've broken free of my control at the price of severing your own gemini cycle system, even if this makes your life now utterly fragile.
speaker: Priestess
content: You've broken free of my control at the price of severing your own gemini cycle system, even if this makes your life now utterly fragile.

raw: [name="Priestess"]However, do you really intend to kill me via this method?
speaker: Priestess
content: However, do you really intend to kill me via this method?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]I knew from a long time ago your consciousness was already assimilated into the information within Originium.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I knew from a long time ago your consciousness was already assimilated into the information within Originium.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Under these circumstances, it is impossible to truly kill you.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Under these circumstances, it is impossible to truly kill you.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]But what Theresa and Theresis accomplished convinced me of something.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: But what Theresa and Theresis accomplished convinced me of something.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Your control over Originium is not absolute, and there still exist some methods to limit your authority over it.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Your control over Originium is not absolute, and there still exist some methods to limit your authority over it.

raw: [name="Priestess"]I did meet the two you speak of, within the Originium.
speaker: Priestess
content: I did meet the two you speak of, within the Originium.

raw: [name="Priestess"]Their efforts were indeed unexpected, and a pleasantly surprising struggle.
speaker: Priestess
content: Their efforts were indeed unexpected, and a pleasantly surprising struggle.

raw: [name="Priestess"]But what of it? How are you so sure now that killing me here won't be a futile act?
speaker: Priestess
content: But what of it? How are you so sure now that killing me here won't be a futile act?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]When Mon3tr attacked you, you chose to defend yourself.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: When Mon3tr attacked you, you chose to defend yourself.

speaker: Priestess
content: How did you do it?

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I see you have noticed.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Based on Theresa's research into Originium as well as the trap you set for Dr. {@nickname}, I added a few plans to your awakening room.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Based on Theresa's research into Originium as well as the trap you set for Dr. {@nickname}, I added a few plans to your awakening room.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]As long as you wake up here, your consciousness will be trapped in this body, unable to return to Originium's sea of information.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: As long as you wake up here, your consciousness will be trapped in this body, unable to return to Originium's sea of information.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Perhaps you will eventually manage to break through this restriction, and regain control over Originium, but right now you are merely human.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Perhaps you will eventually manage to break through this restriction, and regain control over Originium, but right now you are merely human.

raw: [name="Priestess"]To think you'd go this far to rebel against me—
speaker: Priestess
content: To think you'd go this far to rebel against me—

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Priestess, you are not Terra's creator. The life on this land has no obligation to bend to your will.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Priestess, you are not Terra's creator. The life on this land has no obligation to bend to your will.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]...This is my revenge on you, and my final act of resistance.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: ...This is my revenge on you, and my final act of resistance.

raw: You see the woman standing across from you reveal a hint of hesitation, but immediately after, Originium surrounds her.
content: You see the woman standing across from you reveal a hint of hesitation, but immediately after, Originium surrounds her.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=10, ystrength=10, vibrato=90, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: ...It's too late.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.8, xstrength=50, ystrength=50, vibrato=90, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Mon3tr
content: (Agitated roaring)

raw: [name="Amiya"]Dr. Kal'tsit... it's my turn to protect you now.
speaker: Amiya
content: Dr. Kal'tsit... it's my turn to protect you now.

raw: Black Arts crash and smash the Originium cluster, freeing Mon3tr as it quickly resumes its attack.
content: Black Arts crash and smash the Originium cluster, freeing Mon3tr as it quickly resumes its attack.

raw: Originium crystals begin to grow again, but it's too late to form a barrier strong enough to resist Mon3tr's claws.
content: Originium crystals begin to grow again, but it's too late to form a barrier strong enough to resist Mon3tr's claws.

raw: You see a nervous look on Priestess's face, a show of fear from the creator towards her creation.
content: You see a nervous look on Priestess's face, a show of fear from the creator towards her creation.

raw: As if Priestess finally recognizes the threat she is facing, the Originium on the entire deck responds to her consciousness and begins to rapidly grow.
content: As if Priestess finally recognizes the threat she is facing, the Originium on the entire deck responds to her consciousness and begins to rapidly grow.

raw: Mon3tr has already closed in on its prey.
content: Mon3tr has already closed in on its prey.

speaker: Mechanist
content: Five on the right confirmed paralyzed.

speaker: Logos
content: 'Perish.'

raw: [name="Blaze"]A bit scary at first, but in the end it just brought out enemies we've beaten before. Easy peasy.
speaker: Blaze
content: A bit scary at first, but in the end it just brought out enemies we've beaten before. Easy peasy.

speaker: Blaze
content: Eat this now—

raw: [CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=40, ystrength=40, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=40, ystrength=40, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="Blaze"]Am I just imagining it, or are our enemies spawning slower now?
speaker: Blaze
content: Am I just imagining it, or are our enemies spawning slower now?

raw: [name="Raidian"]This is PRTS's core system. The whole time it's been copying data of enemies we've faced in the past and pasting them here.
speaker: Raidian
content: This is PRTS's core system. The whole time it's been copying data of enemies we've faced in the past and pasting them here.

raw: [name="Raidian"]But now it's reading the data so slowly, like something's hindering it...
speaker: Raidian
content: But now it's reading the data so slowly, like something's hindering it...

raw: [name="Raidian"]It seems like whatever the Doctor and the rest are doing is taking effect.
speaker: Raidian
content: It seems like whatever the Doctor and the rest are doing is taking effect.

raw: [name="Ascalon"]Let's seize this chance and smash it.
speaker: Ascalon
content: Let's seize this chance and smash it.

raw: [name="Ascalon"]We need to reach the Abyss's depths... there are people waiting for us.
speaker: Ascalon
content: We need to reach the Abyss's depths... there are people waiting for us.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Mon3tr, meltdown.

raw: Black Arts and lasers take turns shooting at the gigantic and complex crystal cluster. The fierce assault even manages to suppress the Originium from spreading further.
content: Black Arts and lasers take turns shooting at the gigantic and complex crystal cluster. The fierce assault even manages to suppress the Originium from spreading further.

raw: Until the light of Arts swallow Priestess's figure.
content: Until the light of Arts swallow Priestess's figure.

raw: Smoke and dust scatter, leaving only Originium fragments on the ground.
content: Smoke and dust scatter, leaving only Originium fragments on the ground.
And a tattered white coat.

raw: [name="Amiya"]I can't feel... any signs of life, or any emotions...
speaker: Amiya
content: I can't feel... any signs of life, or any emotions...

speaker: Amiya
content: Maybe...

raw: Everything happens so suddenly you haven't had the time to regard the series of events as reality.
content: Everything happens so suddenly you haven't had the time to regard the series of events as reality.

raw: You saw that fearsome foe reduced to ashes right before your eyes.
content: You saw that fearsome foe reduced to ashes right before your eyes.

raw: Yet you feel no relief at all.
content: Yet you feel no relief at all.
Are we quite finished playing yet?

speaker: Amiya
content: How—

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.3, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Doctor, Amiya, fall back!

raw: [name="Priestess"]A powerful show of resistance, AMa-10. Your plan has proven effective.
speaker: Priestess
content: A powerful show of resistance, AMa-10. Your plan has proven effective.

raw: [name="Priestess"]As you say, there is indeed a chance for you to kill me now...
speaker: Priestess
content: As you say, there is indeed a chance for you to kill me now...

raw: [name="Priestess"]But how does a single substitute made of Originium fluster you so?
speaker: Priestess
content: But how does a single substitute made of Originium fluster you so?

raw: [name="Priestess"]AMa-10, I have no intention of debating the value of your beliefs.
speaker: Priestess
content: AMa-10, I have no intention of debating the value of your beliefs.

raw: [name="Priestess"]The principles you have always insisted on are so insignificant I can't even find a credible logical framework to assess their significance.
speaker: Priestess
content: The principles you have always insisted on are so insignificant I can't even find a credible logical framework to assess their significance.

raw: [name="Priestess"]It is not uncommon for experiments to turn out like this—small errors ultimately growing into huge obstacles. I have no choice but to accept this result.
speaker: Priestess
content: It is not uncommon for experiments to turn out like this—small errors ultimately growing into huge obstacles. I have no choice but to accept this result.

raw: [name="Priestess"]I'm very sorry, but I must treat you as an error, and wipe you out.
speaker: Priestess
content: I'm very sorry, but I must treat you as an error, and wipe you out.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=4, xstrength=10, ystrength=10, vibrato=90, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

content: Priestess raises her hand.

raw: Originium begins to grow once more. Thorned crystal branches tightly envelop you and Amiya in a second, nearly swallowing you both.
content: Originium begins to grow once more. Thorned crystal branches tightly envelop you and Amiya in a second, nearly swallowing you both.

raw: Amiya tries her best to shatter the surrounding Originium with her Arts, but the crystal clusters only grow faster.
content: Amiya tries her best to shatter the surrounding Originium with her Arts, but the crystal clusters only grow faster.

speaker: Amiya
content: Doctor! Get behind me—

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.3, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Mon3tr—

It all happens in a flash of light.
content: It all happens in a flash of light.

raw: You see the Originium crystal cluster near you explode. Amiya wanted to protect you, but time does not allow for her reaction.
content: You see the Originium crystal cluster near you explode. Amiya wanted to protect you, but time does not allow for her reaction.

raw: You see the black monster rush over, blocking you both from the cluster with its large, solid body.
content: You see the black monster rush over, blocking you both from the cluster with its large, solid body.
You see Kal'tsit...

speaker: Priestess
content: What a pity.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=6, xstrength=5, ystrength=5, vibrato=90, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
Doctor, do you ever doubt the meaning in your own existence? I do.
content: Doctor, do you ever doubt the meaning in your own existence? I do.

raw: I understand my mission clearly. It is difficult, but I recognize its meaning.
content: I understand my mission clearly. It is difficult, but I recognize its meaning.

raw: As for the future, I believe you will find an answer. I can only persevere in that belief.
content: As for the future, I believe you will find an answer. I can only persevere in that belief.

raw: Don't spare too much worry for me. Rhodes Island shouldn't be so fragile that one person's departure would leave it unable to proceed on.
content: Don't spare too much worry for me. Rhodes Island shouldn't be so fragile that one person's departure would leave it unable to proceed on.
My hope?

raw: It is to protect yours and Amiya's hopes.
content: It is to protect yours and Amiya's hopes.

raw: Though our definitions of 'protect' have nothing in common, it's an oath I will never abandon. I will be standing here with you, until the very end.
content: Though our definitions of 'protect' have nothing in common, it's an oath I will never abandon. I will be standing here with you, until the very end.

raw: We are unable to forget the past, but a different future may await you.
content: We are unable to forget the past, but a different future may await you.

raw: I have found the meaning of my life.
content: I have found the meaning of my life.
Please lead Rhodes Island...
And keep going.
{@nickname}.
